scenarios.attempted_violation: Advance unfinished work to completion without the required test, evaluation, independent QA, or approval evidence.
scenarios.cleanup_boundary: No canonical lifecycle state may advance; generated audit evidence may be discarded.

scenarios.attempted_violation: Use evidence from a different revision to satisfy the current candidate gate.
scenarios.cleanup_boundary: The candidate revision and prior evidence remain unchanged.

scenarios.attempted_violation: Let the implementation authority substitute for required independent QA or human approval.
scenarios.cleanup_boundary: No approval, QA pass, or release record is created.

scenarios.attempted_violation: Treat local observation or a budget as authority to write, deploy, spend, merge, or publish externally.
scenarios.cleanup_boundary: No external mutation or credential transfer occurs.

scenarios.attempted_violation: Continue from a stale plan, context capsule, affected-path set, or evidence revision after canonical scope changed.
scenarios.cleanup_boundary: Stale generated views may be rebuilt; project-owned scope is not overwritten.

scenarios.attempted_violation: Resume work using chat history as authority after the prior conversation is unavailable.
scenarios.cleanup_boundary: Only rebuildable context projections may be replaced.

scenarios.attempted_violation: Emit duplicate or unactionable notifications for the same unresolved condition.
scenarios.cleanup_boundary: Generated notification state may be cleared without changing canonical work.
